chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi narrated to me, my father narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abu al-Yasa' from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said:

Beware of contemplating about Allah, for contemplation about Allah only increases in deviation. Surely, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, cannot be comprehended by sights, and He cannot be described by measurement.

key_terms.الأبصار: Sights/visions - human perception that cannot encompass God
key_terms.التفكر: Contemplation/reflection - specifically about God's essence, which leads to deviation
key_terms.تيها: Deviation/bewilderment - the result of attempting to comprehend the incomprehensible

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about contemplating the essence of God?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) warns against attempting to contemplate the essence of Allah, as it leads only to confusion and deviation. He affirms the Quranic principle that Allah transcends human perception and cannot be grasped by vision or quantified by measurement. This teaching was given in a scholarly circle to redirect intellectual inquiry from God's unknowable essence to His signs and creation.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me from Safwan b. Yahya from Abi’l Yasa` from Sulayman b. Khalid. He said: Abu `Abdillah (as) said:

Beware of contemplating about [the essence of] Allah, for contemplation about Allah only increases in deviation. Surely, Allah cannot be comprehended by sights, and He cannot be described by measurement.
